description: Introducing the Baseus Crystal Shine 20W Fast Charging & Data Cable USB Type C to Lightning 20W 1.2m, the perfect accessory for your mobile devices. Get your hands on the Baseus Crystal Shine 20W Fast Charging & Data Cable USB Type C to Lightning 20W 1.2m today and experience the convenience and efficiency it has to offer.
